description: Evaluation criteria taxonomy - 16 common RFP evaluation criteria by sector. Synthesized by the team because the provided sample dataset omitted the taxonomy sheet referenced in the problem statement.

criteria.name: Technical Approach & Methodology
criteria.description: Soundness, completeness and innovation of the proposed technical solution and delivery methodology.

criteria.name: Relevant Past Experience
criteria.description: Evidence of successfully delivered projects of similar scope, scale and sector.

criteria.name: Financial Proposal / Cost
criteria.description: Total cost of ownership, price realism and value for money.

criteria.name: Key Personnel Qualifications
criteria.description: CVs, certifications and availability of the proposed team.

criteria.name: Project Timeline & Work Plan
criteria.description: Realistic, milestone-based schedule with resource loading.

criteria.name: Quality Assurance Plan
criteria.description: QA/QC processes, inspection regimes and acceptance criteria.

criteria.name: Certifications & Standards Compliance
criteria.description: ISO 9001/27001, CMMI, CE Mark, PEC registration and other mandated standards.

criteria.name: Financial Stability
criteria.description: Audited statements, turnover thresholds, bank guarantees and bid security.

criteria.name: Local Presence & Support Capability
criteria.description: In-country offices, support SLAs and spare/parts logistics.

criteria.name: Risk Management Plan
criteria.description: Identification, mitigation and contingency planning for delivery risks.

criteria.name: Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
criteria.description: HSE policy, incident record and site safety management.

criteria.name: Data Security & Privacy
criteria.description: Information security controls, data residency and privacy compliance.

criteria.name: Training & Knowledge Transfer
criteria.description: End-user training plans, documentation and capacity building.

criteria.name: Warranty & Post-Implementation Support
criteria.description: Warranty period, support tiers, response times and maintenance terms.

criteria.name: Innovation & Value Addition
criteria.description: Differentiated capabilities, automation or value-added services beyond the base scope.

criteria.name: Sustainability & Environmental Impact
criteria.description: Environmental footprint, green materials/energy and social impact.
